en: The people serve the LORD all the days of Joshua and of the elders who outlive him.
Joshua dies at 110, and a generation grows up who do not know the LORD.
The Israelites abandon the LORD and serve the Baals and the Ashtoreths.
The LORD's anger burns, and he hands them over to raiders and enemies.
The LORD raises up judges who save them, for he pities their groaning.
When each judge dies, the people turn back and act more corruptly than before.
The LORD leaves the nations in the land to test Israel.
zh: 約書亞在世和比他長壽的長老在世的日子，百姓都事奉耶和華。
約書亞一百一十歲死了，後來興起的一代人不認識耶和華。
以色列人離棄耶和華，去事奉巴力和亞斯她錄。
耶和華的怒氣發作，把他們交在搶掠者和仇敵手中。
耶和華興起士師拯救他們，因為他憐憫他們的哀聲。
每當士師一死，百姓就轉回去，行得比從前更敗壞。
耶和華留下那些民族在地上，用來試驗以色列。

about.en: Othniel, the first judge, and the pattern at work
about.zh: 第一位士師俄陀聶，同樣的循環

about.en: No king in Israel; everyone did what was right in his own eyes
about.zh: 那時以色列中沒有王，各人隨意行事

about.en: Paul: God gave them judges until Samuel
about.zh: 保羅說神賜他們士師，直到撒母耳

about.en: Gideon, Barak, Samson and Jephthah among the faithful
about.zh: 基甸、巴拉、參孫、耶弗他的信心

en: The time of the judges ended with Saul, about 1050 BC. It began about 1375 BC or about 1200 BC, depending on the date of the exodus.
The Hebrew shofet, "judge", means a leader who rescued and governed the people, not only one who decided cases in court.
Baal was the Canaanite storm god, thought to send rain; Ashtoreth (Astarte) was a goddess. Texts found at Ugarit in Syria, from about 1300 BC, tell of Baal.
zh: 士師時代到掃羅為止，約在主前1050年；開始於約主前1375年或約主前1200年，視出埃及的年代而定。
希伯來文「士師」（shofet）指拯救並治理百姓的領袖，不只是在法庭判案的人。
巴力是迦南人的風暴之神，被認為能降雨；亞斯她錄是女神。在敘利亞烏加列出土、約主前1300年的文獻記載了巴力的故事。

en: Jabin king of Canaan, with 900 iron chariots, oppresses Israel for twenty years.
Deborah, a prophet, judges Israel under the Palm of Deborah.
She tells Barak the LORD commands him to gather ten thousand men at Mount Tabor.
Barak will go only if Deborah goes; she goes, but says a woman will defeat Sisera.
The LORD throws Sisera's army into panic, and Sisera flees on foot.
Jael, wife of Heber the Kenite, kills Sisera with a tent peg in her tent.
Deborah and Barak sing a song of the LORD's victory, and the land has peace forty years.
zh: 迦南王耶賓有九百輛鐵車，壓迫以色列人二十年。
女先知底波拉在底波拉棕樹下作以色列的士師。
她告訴巴拉，耶和華吩咐他在他泊山集結一萬人。
巴拉說底波拉同去他才去；她就同去，卻說西西拉要被交在一個女人手中。
耶和華使西西拉的全軍潰亂，西西拉徒步逃跑。
基尼人希百的妻子雅億在帳棚裏用橛子殺了西西拉。
底波拉和巴拉歌頌耶和華的勝利，國中太平四十年。

about.en: Joshua had earlier burned Hazor
about.zh: 約書亞早先焚燒夏瑣

about.en: A psalm remembers Sisera and Jabin at the Kishon
about.zh: 詩篇記念基順河邊的西西拉和耶賓

about.en: Barak among those who acted by faith
about.zh: 巴拉列在憑信心行事的人中

en: Mount Tabor, in Galilee, rises alone to about 575 m at the edge of the Jezreel Valley. The Kishon River flows through the valley to the sea near Haifa.
Hazor, in upper Galilee, was the largest Canaanite city in the land. Excavations show it was destroyed by fire in the 1200s BC.
Chariots were the strongest weapon of the age. The Kishon floods in the winter rains, and its plain becomes heavy mud.
zh: 他泊山在加利利，孤峰聳立在耶斯列平原邊緣，海拔約575米。基順河流經這平原，在今海法附近入海。
夏瑣位於上加利利，是當地最大的迦南城。考古發現它在主前十三世紀被火焚毀。
戰車是當時最強的武器。基順河在冬季雨水中氾濫，河邊平原變成泥沼。

en: Midian and the people of the east raid Israel for seven years, like swarms of locusts.
The angel of the LORD finds Gideon threshing wheat in a winepress to hide it.
"The LORD is with you, mighty warrior." Gideon asks why all this has happened.
Gideon says his clan is the weakest; the LORD says, "I will be with you."
Fire from the rock consumes Gideon's offering, and he builds an altar: The LORD Is Peace.
At night Gideon tears down his father's altar of Baal and is named Jerubbaal.
Gideon asks for signs with a fleece, wet and then dry, and God gives them.
zh: 米甸人和東方人侵擾以色列七年，多如蝗蟲。
耶和華的使者看見基甸在酒醡裏打麥子，要躲避米甸人。
「大能的勇士啊，耶和華與你同在！」基甸問為甚麼遭遇這一切事。
基甸說他的宗族最弱；耶和華說：「我必與你同在。」
火從磐石出來燒盡基甸的供物，他築了一座壇，名叫「耶和華是平安」。
基甸在夜間拆毀他父親的巴力壇，因此被稱為耶路‧巴力。
基甸用羊毛求兆頭，先濕後乾，神都照他所求的成就。

about.en: Moses also objects, and God says, "I will be with you"
about.zh: 摩西也推辭，神說「我必與你同在」

about.en: Gideon refuses to be king: the LORD will rule over you
about.zh: 基甸不肯作王：耶和華要管理你們

about.en: Gideon among those who acted by faith
about.zh: 基甸列在憑信心行事的人中

en: The Midianites were desert peoples from east of the Gulf of Aqaba, in northwest Arabia.
Grain was usually threshed on an open, windy hilltop floor. A winepress was a pit cut in rock for treading grapes, a place out of sight.
The site of Gideon's town, Ophrah, is not known for certain.
zh: 米甸人是住在亞喀巴灣以東、阿拉伯西北部的沙漠民族。
打麥子通常在山頂通風的禾場上。酒醡是在岩石上鑿出來踩葡萄的坑，不容易被人看見。
基甸的家鄉俄弗拉在哪裏，至今不能確定。

en: The LORD says Gideon has too many men, or Israel might boast it saved itself.
Twenty-two thousand who are afraid go home; ten thousand remain.
At the water, three hundred men lap; with them the LORD will save Israel.
In the Midianite camp Gideon hears a dream of a barley loaf flattening a tent.
The three hundred carry rams' horns and torches hidden in empty jars.
At night they blow the horns, smash the jars and shout, "A sword for the LORD and for Gideon!"
The LORD sets the Midianites against each other, and they flee.
zh: 耶和華說跟隨基甸的人太多，免得以色列誇口是自己救了自己。
懼怕的二萬二千人回去了，剩下一萬人。
在水邊有三百人舔水；耶和華要用他們拯救以色列。
基甸在米甸營中聽見一人的夢：一個大麥餅把帳棚撞倒了。
三百人拿着羊角號，和藏着火把的空瓶。
他們夜間吹號、打碎瓶子，大聲喊：「耶和華和基甸的刀！」
耶和華使米甸人自相殘殺，他們就逃跑了。

about.en: Midian is brought low; the land has peace forty years
about.zh: 米甸被制伏，國中太平四十年

about.en: Isaiah: the oppressor broken "as on the day of Midian"
about.zh: 以賽亞：重軛被折斷，如米甸的日子

about.en: A psalm remembers Oreb and Zeeb
about.zh: 詩篇記念俄立和西伊伯

en: The spring of Harod (Ein Harod) lies at the foot of Mount Gilboa. The hill of Moreh stands across the Jezreel Valley to the north.
Israelites divided the night into three watches. Gideon attacked at the start of the middle watch, just after the guards changed.
The ram's horn (shofar) was blown as a signal in war and worship; it is still blown in synagogues today.
zh: 哈律泉在基利波山腳下；摩利岡在耶斯列平原北面，與它相對。
以色列人把夜間分為三更。基甸在二更初、剛換崗之後進攻。
羊角號（shofar）在打仗和敬拜時吹響作信號；今天猶太會堂仍然吹它。

en: The Philistines rule Israel forty years. An angel tells Manoah's childless wife she will bear a son.
The boy is to be a Nazirite from the womb; no razor may touch his head.
Samson is born, and the Spirit of the LORD begins to stir him.
The Spirit rushes on him, and with bare hands he tears apart a young lion.
His riddle about honey from the lion is learned through his Philistine wife.
He burns the Philistines' grain with foxes and torches.
Tied by men of Judah, he breaks the ropes and strikes down a thousand with a donkey's jawbone.
zh: 非利士人轄制以色列四十年。天使告訴瑪挪亞不能生育的妻子，她將要生一個兒子。
這孩子一出母胎就是拿細耳人，不可用剃刀剃他的頭。
參孫出生了，耶和華的靈開始感動他。
耶和華的靈猛然臨到他，他赤手空拳撕裂一隻少壯的獅子。
他以獅子和蜂蜜出的謎語，被人透過他的非利士妻子探出了謎底。
他用狐狸和火把燒毀非利士人的莊稼。
猶大人把他捆綁，他掙斷繩子，用一塊驢腮骨擊殺了一千人。

about.en: The law of the Nazirite vow
about.zh: 拿細耳人許願的條例

about.en: John's birth announced: he must never drink wine
about.zh: 預言約翰出生：淡酒濃酒都不喝

about.en: Samson among those who acted by faith
about.zh: 參孫列在憑信心行事的人中

en: The Philistines came by sea and settled on the southern coast of Canaan in the 1100s BC. Their five cities were Gaza, Ashkelon, Ashdod, Ekron and Gath.
Zorah and Eshtaol lie in the Sorek Valley, west of Jerusalem. Philistine Timnah is often identified with Tel Batash, lower down the same valley.
Excavations at Philistine cities find many pig bones, unlike the Israelite villages in the hills, where pork was rarely eaten.
zh: 非利士人從海上而來，在主前十二世紀定居在迦南南部沿海。他們的五座城是迦薩、亞實基倫、亞實突、以革倫和迦特。
瑣拉和以實陶在耶路撒冷以西的梭烈谷。非利士人的亭拿通常被認為是同一山谷下游的巴塔什丘。
非利士城市出土大量豬骨；山地的以色列村落則很少吃豬肉。

title.zh: 參孫的失敗和最後的禱告

en: At Gaza Samson carries off the doors and gateposts of the city gate.
The Philistine rulers offer Delilah silver to learn the secret of his strength.
Three times he deceives her, and three times he breaks free.
Worn out by her pressing, he tells her he is a Nazirite and has never been shaved.
His hair is shaved, the LORD leaves him, and the Philistines blind him and make him grind grain.
At Dagon's feast, his hair growing again, Samson prays, "Please remember me."
He pushes the temple's pillars; it falls, and he dies with the Philistines.
zh: 參孫在迦薩把城門的門扇和門柱扛走了。
非利士人的首領答應給大利拉銀子，要她探出他力氣的祕密。
他三次欺騙她，三次都掙脫了。
她天天催逼他，他就告訴她自己是拿細耳人，從未剃過頭。
他的頭髮被剃，耶和華離開了他；非利士人挖出他的眼睛，叫他推磨。
在大袞的慶典上，參孫的頭髮又長起來，他禱告說：「求你記念我。」
他推倒廟的柱子，廟就倒塌，他與非利士人同死。

about.en: No razor on a Nazirite's head
about.zh: 拿細耳人不可用剃刀剃頭

about.en: Dagon falls before the ark of the LORD
about.zh: 大袞仆倒在耶和華的約櫃前

about.en: Strength out of weakness
about.zh: 從軟弱中變為剛強

en: Gaza, the southernmost Philistine city, lay on the coast road to Egypt; a city of that name stands there today.
A Philistine temple found at Tell Qasile, in today's Tel Aviv, had two central wooden pillars on stone bases holding up the roof.
Turning a millstone to grind grain was work given to slaves and prisoners.
zh: 迦薩是最南面的非利士城，位於通往埃及的沿海大道上；今天那裏仍有同名的城市。
在今特拉維夫的卡西勒丘出土了一座非利士人的廟，屋頂由中間兩根立在石座上的木柱支撐。
推磨磨麥是奴隸和囚犯所做的工作。

en: In a famine Elimelech takes Naomi and their two sons from Bethlehem to Moab.
Elimelech dies; the sons marry Orpah and Ruth, Moabite women, and then both sons die.
Naomi sets out for home and urges her daughters-in-law to go back.
Orpah returns, but Ruth says, "Your people will be my people, and your God my God."
In Bethlehem Naomi says, "Call me Mara, for the Almighty has made my life very bitter."
Ruth gleans in the field of Boaz, a relative of Elimelech.
Boaz protects her and gives her extra grain; Naomi blesses the LORD for his faithful love.
zh: 遇到饑荒，以利米勒帶着拿俄米和兩個兒子從伯利恆往摩押去。
以利米勒死了；兩個兒子娶了摩押女子俄珥巴和路得，後來兩個兒子也死了。
拿俄米動身回鄉，勸兩個兒媳回去。
俄珥巴回去了，路得卻說：「你的同胞就是我的同胞，你的神就是我的神。」
拿俄米在伯利恆說：「要叫我瑪拉，因為全能者使我非常愁苦。」
路得在以利米勒的親戚波阿斯的田裏拾麥穗。
波阿斯保護她，又多給她麥穗；拿俄米稱頌耶和華的慈愛。

about.en: Leave the edges of the harvest for the poor and the foreigner
about.zh: 收割時要留下田角給窮人和寄居者

about.en: The origin of the Moabites
about.zh: 摩押人的起源

about.en: Ruth in the family line of Jesus
about.zh: 路得列在耶穌的家譜中

en: Moab lay east of the Dead Sea, in today's Jordan. The Moabite Stone, about 840 BC, is an inscription of Mesha, a later king of Moab.
Bethlehem lies about 9 km south of Jerusalem. Its name means "house of bread".
Barley was harvested about April, wheat a few weeks later, about May to June.
zh: 摩押在死海以東，今約旦境內。約主前840年的「摩押石碑」是後來摩押王米沙的碑文。
伯利恆在耶路撒冷以南約9公里，名字的意思是「餅之家」。
大麥約在四月收割，小麥晚幾個星期，約在五月至六月。

en: Naomi sends Ruth to the threshing floor where Boaz is winnowing barley.
Ruth asks Boaz to spread his garment over her, for he is a guardian-redeemer.
Boaz promises to act, but a closer relative has the first right.
At the town gate, before ten elders, the closer relative gives up his right.
He takes off his sandal, and Boaz buys Elimelech's land and takes Ruth as his wife.
Ruth bears a son, Obed, and the women praise the LORD with Naomi.
Obed is the father of Jesse, the father of David.
zh: 拿俄米打發路得到波阿斯簸大麥的禾場去。
路得求波阿斯用衣襟遮蓋她，因為他是至近的親屬。
波阿斯答應辦理，但有一位更近的親屬有優先權利。
在城門口十位長老面前，那位更近的親屬放棄了他的權利。
他脫下鞋來；波阿斯買下以利米勒的產業，娶路得為妻。
路得生了兒子俄備得，婦女們和拿俄米一同稱頌耶和華。
俄備得是耶西的父親，耶西是大衛的父親。

about.en: The nearest redeemer buys back a relative's land
about.zh: 至近的親屬要贖回親人的產業

about.en: A widow, her husband's brother and the sandal
about.zh: 寡婦、亡夫的兄弟和脫鞋的條例

about.en: Boaz, Ruth, Obed, Jesse and David in Jesus' line
about.zh: 耶穌家譜中的波阿斯、路得、大衛

en: Grain was winnowed on a threshing floor in the evening breeze: tossed into the air so the wind carried off the chaff.
The town gate was where elders met, cases were heard and business was witnessed.
An ephah was a dry measure, often reckoned at about 22 litres, though estimates vary.
zh: 人們在傍晚的風中在禾場上簸穀：把穀物揚起，讓風吹走糠秕。
城門口是長老聚集、審理案件和作見證交易的地方。
伊法是乾量單位，常估算為約22升，但各家估計不一。

en: Elkanah has two wives; Peninnah has children, but Hannah has none, and Peninnah provokes her.
At Shiloh Hannah prays in tears and vows to give a son to the LORD.
Eli thinks she is drunk, then blesses her: may God grant what she asked.
Hannah bears a son and names him Samuel, "because I asked the LORD for him."
After he is weaned she brings him to Eli at Shiloh and gives him to the LORD.
Hannah prays: no one is holy like the LORD; he brings low and lifts up.
Samuel serves before the LORD, and the LORD gives Hannah five more children.
zh: 以利加拿有兩個妻子；毗尼拿有兒女，哈拿卻沒有，毗尼拿常激怒她。
哈拿在示羅流淚禱告，許願要把兒子獻給耶和華。
以利以為她喝醉了，後來卻祝福她，願神賜她所求的。
哈拿生了一個兒子，給他起名叫撒母耳，因為「他是我從耶和華那裏求來的」。
孩子斷奶以後，她把他帶到示羅以利那裏，獻給耶和華。
哈拿禱告說：沒有誰像耶和華那樣聖潔；他使人卑微，也使人升高。
撒母耳在耶和華面前事奉；耶和華又賜哈拿五個兒女。

about.en: Mary's song, which echoes Hannah's
about.zh: 馬利亞的頌歌，與哈拿的禱告相呼應

about.en: Jesus grew in favor with God and people (compare 1 Sam 2:26)
about.zh: 耶穌在神和人面前蒙喜愛

about.en: No razor: the Nazirite vow
about.zh: 不用剃刀剃頭：拿細耳人的願

en: Shiloh, where the tabernacle stood, is Khirbet Seilun, about 30 km north of Jerusalem.
In the ancient Near East children were often nursed until about two or three years old.
The family went up to Shiloh each year for a sacrifice, and the worshippers ate part of it in a meal before the LORD.
zh: 會幕所在的示羅就是今天的塞倫廢墟，在耶路撒冷以北約30公里。
古代近東的孩子常吃奶到兩三歲左右。
這家人每年上示羅獻祭，敬拜的人在耶和華面前吃祭物的一部分。

en: In those days the word of the LORD is rare. The boy Samuel sleeps in the temple where the ark is.
The LORD calls Samuel; he runs to Eli and says, "Here I am. You called me."
After the third call Eli understands that the LORD is calling the boy.
Samuel answers, "Speak, for your servant is listening."
The LORD says he will carry out his judgment against Eli's family.
In the morning Samuel tells Eli everything; Eli says, "He is the LORD."
The LORD is with Samuel, and all Israel knows he is a prophet of the LORD.
zh: 那時耶和華的話很少。孩子撒母耳睡在有約櫃的耶和華的殿裏。
耶和華呼喚撒母耳，他跑到以利那裏說：「我在這裏，你叫我。」
第三次以後，以利明白是耶和華在呼喚這孩子。
撒母耳回答：「請說，你的僕人在聽。」
耶和華說他要向以利的家施行審判。
早晨撒母耳把一切都告訴以利；以利說：「他是耶和華。」
耶和華與撒母耳同在，全以色列都知道他是耶和華的先知。

about.en: A man of God's warning to Eli's family
about.zh: 神人對以利家的警告

about.en: Isaiah: "Here I am. Send me."
about.zh: 以賽亞說：「我在這裏，請差遣我。」

about.en: Peter: all the prophets from Samuel on
about.zh: 彼得說：從撒母耳以來的眾先知

en: The lamp of God was the tabernacle lampstand, kept burning from evening until morning (Exodus 27:20-21).
"From Dan to Beersheba" means the whole land: Dan in the far north, Beersheba in the south, more than 200 km apart.
Samuel's age is not given; the Jewish historian Josephus, writing about AD 93, says he was twelve.
zh: 神的燈就是會幕裏的燈臺，從晚上點到早晨（出埃及記27章20至21節）。
「從但到別是巴」指全地：但在最北，別是巴在南，相距二百多公里。
經文沒有記撒母耳的年齡；猶太史學家約瑟夫約在主後93年寫道他當時十二歲。

en: Defeated by the Philistines, Israel brings the ark of the covenant from Shiloh into the camp.
Israel is defeated again; the ark is captured, and Hophni and Phinehas die.
Hearing the news, Eli falls backward and dies; his grandson is named Ichabod.
In Ashdod the statue of Dagon falls face down before the ark.
The LORD strikes the Philistine cities with tumors as the ark is moved from city to city.
After seven months the Philistines send the ark back on a cart pulled by two cows.
The cows go straight to Beth-shemesh; later the ark is taken to Kiriath-jearim.
zh: 以色列被非利士人打敗，就從示羅把約櫃抬到營中。
以色列又被打敗；約櫃被擄，何弗尼和非尼哈都死了。
以利聽見消息，往後跌倒死了；他的孫子取名叫以迦博。
在亞實突，大袞像臉伏於地，仆倒在約櫃前。
約櫃從一城轉到另一城，耶和華就用腫瘤擊打非利士人的城。
七個月後，非利士人用兩頭母牛拉的車把約櫃送回。
母牛直往伯‧示麥去；後來約櫃被接到基列‧耶琳。

about.en: God abandoned Shiloh and let the ark be captured
about.zh: 神離棄示羅，使約櫃被擄

about.en: Jeremiah: go and see what God did to Shiloh
about.zh: 耶利米說：去看神向示羅所做的

about.en: David later brings up the ark
about.zh: 後來大衛把約櫃運上來

en: Aphek, where the Philistines camped, is Tel Aphek at the source of the Yarkon River, east of today's Tel Aviv.
Ekron is Tel Miqne. An inscription found there in 1996 names the city and its king, confirming the site.
Ashdod, Ekron and Beth-shemesh lie in the lowlands between the coast and the hills of Judah.
zh: 非利士人安營的亞弗是雅孔河源頭的亞弗丘，在今特拉維夫以東。
以革倫就是米克尼丘；1996年在那裏出土的碑文提到這城和它的王，證實了地點。
亞實突、以革倫和伯‧示麥都位於沿海和猶大山地之間的低地。

en: Samuel grows old; his sons, judges at Beersheba, take bribes and twist justice.
The elders come to Ramah and ask for a king to judge them, like all the nations.
Samuel is displeased and prays to the LORD.
The LORD says, "It is not you they have rejected; they have rejected me."
Samuel warns them: a king will take their sons, daughters, fields and a tenth of their harvest.
The people refuse to listen: "We must have a king over us."
The LORD tells Samuel, "Listen to them and give them a king."
zh: 撒母耳年老了；他在別是巴作士師的兒子貪財受賄，屈枉公義。
長老們來到拉瑪，求他立一個王治理他們，像列國一樣。
撒母耳很不喜歡，就向耶和華禱告。
耶和華說：「他們不是厭棄你，而是厭棄我。」
撒母耳警告他們：王會徵用他們的兒女、田地，又取他們收成的十分之一。
百姓不肯聽：「我們一定要有一個王治理我們。」
耶和華對撒母耳說：「你要聽從他們，為他們立王。」

about.en: The law for a king in Israel
about.zh: 以色列立王的條例

about.en: Gideon: the LORD will rule over you
about.zh: 基甸說：耶和華要管理你們

about.en: Hosea: "I gave you a king in my anger"
about.zh: 何西阿說：我在怒氣中將王賜你

en: Israel asked for a king about 1050 BC, when the Philistines were pressing hard on the hill country.
Samuel's home, Ramah, is often identified with er-Ram, about 8 km north of Jerusalem; some place it elsewhere.
Israel's neighbours, such as the Philistine cities, Ammon and Moab, had kings; Israel's tribes had none until Saul.
zh: 以色列約在主前1050年求立王，那時非利士人對山地的壓迫日益加重。
撒母耳的家鄉拉瑪通常被認為是耶路撒冷以北約8公里的拉姆；也有人認為在別處。
以色列的鄰邦，如非利士諸城、亞捫和摩押，都有君王；以色列各支派在掃羅以前沒有王。
